summary: Compact tile navigation section for space-efficient category linking.
features: Background color options (none, light, pale, dark, bright, custom)
Optional flag display with variant and size options
Grid or slider display with navigation controls
shortDescription: The Inpage Navigation Compact section provides a space-efficient alternative to the larger image tile navigation. It uses smaller tiles perfect for secondary navigation or when many categories need to be displayed without dominating the page. Tiles come in multiple visual variants (default, solid, outline) with extensive background color options to match any theme. Optional flags can highlight sales, new arrivals, or special categories. The responsive layout works as grid or slider with configurable rows and alignment.
